hypothesis: NNsight can wrap an already-attested local torch model object and provide reversible activation intervention without requiring model conversion or a remote provider path; this may make it a stronger future lesion/rescue donor than TransformerLens for exact target identity preservation.
counterhypothesis: Its AST capture, worker-thread mediator, hook orchestration and dependency surface may add more perturbation and maintenance cost than a thin F2-native PyTorch-hook harness, which remains the baseline.
resource_assessment: Potentially lighter than pyvene/TransformerLens as an experimental donor, but not lightweight enough for automatic core adoption; measure against native hooks before E5.
next_discriminator: E2 comparative design across NNsight, pyvene, TransformerLens and native hooks once exact local approximately-0.8B model/J-Space ABI and loader identity are available.
